title: Create shared secret redaction policy and detector foundation
verify: Run required gates and attach output under .tasks/TASK-011/: redaction unit tests: pytest backend/tests/privacy backend/tests/security -k redaction; memory bank lint: node scripts/mb-lint.mjs
Confirm task verification targets are satisfied: test:privacy.secret-redaction-surfaces; Known secret patterns are redacted; High-risk uncertain payload is rejected or truncated
Validate listed constraints and invariants against the implementation and record any exception as a blocker before closure.
Run /verify and /red-verify before closure, record VERDICT: PASS and SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, and include HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done plus ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present as standalone evidence.
evidence_required: Unit tests for known secret classes and configured secret-like patterns
Evidence that uncertain high-risk redaction rejects or truncates instead of publishing raw payload
T3 human checkpoint and rollback/recovery note before closure
constraints: Secret/auth material includes sessions, cookies, bearer tokens, CSRF tokens, refresh tokens, reset material, .env values, API keys, database credentials, connector credentials, webhook secrets, private keys, and secret-like user text
Do not store raw secret value plus a separate redacted flag
Use stable redacted markers or non-reversible redacted refs/hashes where correlation is required
invariants: NEVER log or export secrets, API keys, tokens, .env values, credentials, or auth material
Redaction runs before persistence or publication into forbidden surfaces
verification_targets: High-risk uncertain payload is rejected or truncated
